messages:
Nina: quick sanity check on rollout metadata fields before i write the follow-up RFC. trying to avoid yet another ambiguous ttl field.
Arjun: this is overdue. we keep conflating eviction/placement semantics with client caching propogation.
Keerthana: can we explicitly separate server placement lease vs client caching hint? i've seen caches hang onto pins because sdk honored expiry_at which was ahead of actual eviction.
Nina: proposal:
- placement_lease_seconds (server-only) -> authoritative for node eviction scheduling
- client_hint_ttl_seconds (client-visible) -> SDKs should use for local cache invalidation
- grace_seconds (server-only) -> short extra window for graceful fallback before hard eviction
- rollout_id (string) -> unique id for the rollout event
- applied_by (string) -> identifier for who applied the rollout (user/git-sha)
Arjun: backwards compat: server should still populate expiry_at (iso) for older clients but mark as deprecated. also include effective_until_iso for debugging.
Keerthana: we should include a tiny fingerprint so proxies can detect model changes cheaply. call it fast_fingerprint (sha256 truncated to 8 hex).
Theo: operational validation: console should block if client_hint_ttl_seconds > placement_lease_seconds and warn otherwise. also add server-side reject for negative/zero TTL values.
infra-bot: config-check: rollout metadata schema v2 -> validated, no conflicts detected.
Nina: error codes: request-level reasons need to be distinct: PIN_MISMATCH, MODEL_NOT_FOUND, STALE_LEASE. SDKs should map these to distinct exceptions so caller code can react.
Arjun: telemetry: emit event when metadata changes: rollout_id, old/new fingerprint, old/new placement_lease_seconds, and a downgrade boolean. helps detect accidental rollbacks.
Keerthana: migration story for SDKs: keep honoring expiry_at until new SDK opt-in header is sent: X-Rollout-Semantics: v2. then server can start trimming deprecated fields in responses to strict clients.
Nina: i will draft the followup RFC with sample payloads, validation matrix, and SDK migration guide. aim to ship the console guard + server validation in the same release.
Theo: i'll prepare dashboard queries for rollout_id and fingerprint diffs to spot regressions.
Nina: thanks, folks. i'll ping once the draft is up.
Arjun: +1, nice and actionable.
